releaseNotes: Add console level classification and history management features
changelog: Introduced ConsoleLevel enum to categorize console messages (APP, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, SYSTEM).
Implemented classifyConsoleLine function to classify console output based on predefined patterns.
Added console level color mapping for UI representation based on message severity.
Created ConsoleHistoryRules for managing command history with deduplication and size limits.
Added unit tests for ConsoleHistoryRules and console level classification to ensure functionality and correctness.
Updated string resources for console toolbar and command history in both Arabic and English.
